I built a website for a homestay in Dehradun.

It was a paying client and they now have their own website.

I am Anmol, founder of AR Designs, based in Himachal Pradesh. I build websites, AI tools and lead generation systems for small businesses.

posts.bluesky: Many reel scripts read like essays instead of spoken lines. Keep it short, start with the customer's question, and speak naturally. DM SCRIPT to discuss a reel script that fits your business. 📱

replies.reply: Hi, thanks for messaging. I write reel scripts in Hinglish or English — a hook, body, and call to action paced for 30 to 60 seconds. Quick question: what do you want viewers to do after watching — call, WhatsApp, or visit your shop? We can fix the price only after you approve the script.

replies.if_they_say: do you do this for my kind of business?
replies.reply: Hi, I write scripts for any small business that talks to customers — shops, cafes, clinics, gyms, salons. What does your business sell, and what is the one question customers ask you most?
Of course. I can send a one-page checklist: the five lines every business reel script needs. Is the hesitation about the script, or whether reels fit your business right now?

parts.voiceover: Camera ke samne bolna kya hai, samajh nahi aata?
parts.story: Cold blue laptop screen shows a stiff script line; hands delete it, lamp glow shifts warm, revealing a natural Hinglish line ready to record.
parts.flow_prompt:
A deeply relatable non-commercial indie-film style cinematic micro-story for 'AR Designs', shot on ARRI Alexa Mini LF with a 100mm Macro Anamorphic lens, 4K resolution, 60fps, Kodak Vision3 500T film emulation with rich halation, a warm 3200K tungsten architectural desk lamp casting soft diffused shadows, in a minimalist white workspace with a Nordic oak wood desk, featuring a Space Silver MacBook Pro.
[00:00-00:03 / Story 0-3s] A locked-off wide shot on a 35mm anamorphic lens at f/2.8 holds on the cold blue glow from the Space Silver MacBook Pro screen flooding the Nordic oak desk. The stiff robotic English sentence glows on screen while brushed aluminium reflects harsh light. A fingertip hovers above the trackpad, seen only as a blurred reflection in the screen glass. The 3200K tungsten lamp begins to brighten, casting diffused shadows. Volumetric dust motes hang still before drifting into emerging gold. Crisp glass reflections shift from cold blue to tungsten halation.
[00:03-00:06 / Story 3-6s] A horizontal slider tracking shot alongside the cursor on a 100mm macro anamorphic lens at f/2.0 follows the hand as it deletes the stiff sentence in one clean sweep across the Space Silver MacBook Pro keyboard. The cold blue screen light retreats as the warm 3200K tungsten lamp floods the desk with gold. Rich halation glows around the matte-white architectural lamp shade. The natural Hinglish line appears on screen with soft amber and teal pacing tags. Volumetric dust motes dance in golden light while crisp glass reflections show warm ambience.
[00:06-00:08 / Story 6-8s] A crane-style pull-back on a 50mm anamorphic lens at f/2.0 reveals the Space Silver MacBook Pro sitting open with the Hinglish script ready on screen. The 3200K tungsten lamp fills the white workspace with soft gold light and soft diffused shadows. Hands rest relaxed on the Nordic oak desk beside a sleek studio microphone. Brushed aluminium catches the glow while volumetric dust motes float slowly in the air. Crisp glass reflections frame the scene.
[00:08-00:10 / Story 8-10s] A dolly zoom-out on a 100mm macro anamorphic lens at f/2.0 ends on a locked clean frame of the Space Silver MacBook Pro screen showing the Hinglish line in warm gold glow. Empty space sits beside the laptop for typography. Crisp glass reflections and brushed aluminium frame the shot while volumetric dust motes settle. This final frame sets up the next clip’s cursor highlight and swipe.
Audio & Voiceover Sync: A tense silence opens the clip. A single heavy key click breaks the quiet, followed by rhythmic ASMR mechanical keystrokes as the finger works the trackpad. A decisive delete-key thud marks the stop, then a warm lo-fi ambient synth pad swells in. A relieved exhale breathes through the gold, ending on a lingering vinyl tail that fades back into silence. Warm, intimate, conversational, like a friend voiceover: "Camera ke samne bolna kya hai, samajh nahi aata?"
